Moonlight Otaku Nights

VEND WITH US.

Tables at QXT's nights and (soon) the Mulberry festival. Tier pricing depends on location and event size — we'll send the rate card after we review your application.

Conventions are great for volume. They're also brutal on margins — four-figure booth fees, $300 hotel rooms, three days of standing, then you do the math at midnight and realize you broke even.

Moonlight is the opposite shape.

Why vendors keep coming back:

  • Low booth cost. Our top-tier tables are a fraction of a con booth — and there are only 8–12 vendors total per night, so you're not buried in a sea of 200.
  • 5-hour event, not 3 days. Set up at 8, doors at 9, out by 3am. One night. One trip. Done.
  • The crowd has cash. 21+, employed, anime-spending. Average attendee buys 2–3 items across the night. Pin sellers report $300–$700 nights regularly.
  • You're part of the room. We light your table, drive foot traffic to it, and shoutout standout vendors on stage and on socials after the night.
We're picky on purpose. If 4 people sell the same printed-on-Amazon pin, none of you do well. We curate the floor so every vendor has its own lane: art, apparel, accessories, plush/figures, food. One slot per category gets first dibs.

What you bring:

  • Your products (we don't take consignment cuts — you keep 100% of sales).
  • A way to take payments (most use Square/Stripe; cash is fine too).
  • Display setup if you want something nicer than a tablecloth — grid walls fit, banners fit, LEDs fit.
  • For food: NJ Temp Food License (we'll help you sort it for the festival).

Fill out the form. The faster you reply, the higher the chance you get your preferred tier for the next night.
